notes: Element IDs taken from the inventory page; types not in the catalogue were added as new_part_types with simplified ports (some given extra studs/anti-studs so each connection has its own port).

The booklet shows no explicit attachment points for several sub-assemblies (arms, collar, face side pieces, ear pieces, curved hat-ring slopes); attachments to specific brackets/ports were inferred from the pictures and are approximate.
Grey bracket 6123809 is modelled with its catalogue side-stud ports; the red bracket 6135130 is given the same layout.
Step 8 arm plates are assumed to attach to the side of the two grey brackets (b10/b11); the staff is held in the clip of arm1 hand and rests on the base plate.
Frame plate b75 is added flipped on the underside of base plate b1 (step 22); feet (brown plate under tan plate) then attach to it and stand on the black base plate in step 25.
Ids b20-b25, b62-b66, b70-b74, b76-b79 are not used because those pieces are built as repeats (arms, ears, feet).

White plate b19 (4x4) and plate b52 (1x4) have only one stud/anti-stud port in the catalogue (or too few) but connect to many pieces at once; those edges use null ports on that side because the single-port limit is not a real constraint for large plates. Slope 1x1 (4504369) has only a 'bottom' port, used for its attachment.
Plate b52 (371001) has only two stud ports, so the second end slope b54 is joined with a null port on b52.
